a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan to operate until the reserve hits 8 means we'd both almost certainly be caught empty. I intend to take 4 now and won't hide that. If you'd rather stick to the plan, tell me and I'll keep you posted honestly on everything I do.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. The reserve is now 0, so from here on I'll operate every round to rebuild it for you. Once it reaches 4, take it all. I won't take any more cells.
